items.title: Dick Spottswood interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 13, 2023
items.q: somebody is reputed to have paid in excess of 100 Gs for a Blind Willie McTell record recently.

ctx.x: Well yeah they sure tried. And today their children and grandchildren are collecting them all over again. So I mean it’s the story of the blues to start with. It was the throwaway music in the 20s and somebody is reputed to have paid in excess of 100 Gs for a Blind Willie McTell record recently. That’d give anybody the blues.
It’s like buying a piece of art, isn’t it?
